notes.title: Seasons, Hunting, Cooking and more added to New Frontier 🏕️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! [i]OMO: New Frontier[/i] Devlog #5 is live over on YouTube.

[b]This update covers a range of new features including:[/b]
[list]
[*]Weather effects and seasons
[*]Building complex, multi-step structures (like a Cabin!)
[*]Cooking with the Mess Kit item
[*]Bow hunting and trapping
[*]A new menu interface, and more!
[/list]

Plus, we were able to build some key features that are [i]not[/i] shown in the devlog—but which are just as important—like game saving, character select, and level management. 


[previewyoutube=qiI10gy2njI;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Let me know what you think of the devlog. 
Thanks for watching! 🌄

- Kyle

notes.title: How I'm building the next On My Own game
notes.notes:
Hey OMO fans - the latest development update for [i]New Frontier[/i] is here!

The latest build of the game has a revamped code base, meaning new items, animals, and features are a lot easier for me to add now. :D

I’ve also been working on a new art style that captures the essence of the first game a bit more than our prototype did. 

[previewyoutube=gqkdezW78mU;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
What do you think about the latest build of New Frontier? Thanks for watching, hope you are having a great summer! ☀️

Kyle
Beach Interactive

notes.title: Dreaming up a "New Frontier"
notes.notes:
“Pre-production” has almost wrapped for [i]On My Own: New Frontier[/i] — meaning the Map, Biomes, Project Plan, scope, and Game Design Document are being finalized in the coming weeks. Reply below with any final requests for items/animals/etc. you’d like to see in the game! 

[previewyoutube=rdoKMoJx5Do;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
I’ve also been designing some brand new characters for the game. To learn more, check out our latest devlog: 

When we first announced New Frontier in late July 2021, our process seemed like a mad dash to get something – [i]anything[/i] – out there. 

But I changed my approach after reflecting on the themes & values of the [i]On My Own[/i] brand: [b]slow, thoughtful living, personal empowerment, and finding beauty in the journey[/b].

I only get one shot to make [i]On My Own: New Frontier[/i], and I’ve been asking myself, “What do I want to say with this game? What have I learned about life that I feel is important to impart?”

So, yeah, that’s what I’ve been working on as I prepare for the next stage: full-on art production and Unity development.

Thanks for reading!

Kyle
Beach Interactive

notes.title: Game Announcement & Cabin Jam!
notes.notes:
Checkout our first devlog video for [i]On My Own: New Frontier[/i], or [u]read the highlights posted below.[/u]

[previewyoutube=AoBxH-sEZdI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Originally Posted to YouTube 7/26/21[/i]

[h2]Video Highlights[/h2]

[u][b]Why we're making a new OMO game:[/b][/u]
Over the past couple years we've received feedback from [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/351730/On_My_Own/]On My Own[/url][/i] (OMO) fans asking for additional content and features to be added to the game.

After reviewing the OMO codebase and some of our original design decisions, we realized how much we'd need to rework the game in order to expand it. We decided it was best to retain the original OMO as it was and instead start working on a sequel built from the ground up.


[u][b]Wilderness Living:[/b][/u]
In addition to the survival mechanics of the first game, players will be able to set down roots in the wilderness, building out a frontier home. They'll also be able to use a tent to roam freely and discover new landmarks. 


[u][b]Progress on the Game:[/b][/u]
We currently have a playable prototype that we built with guest developer [url=https://ruben-tipparach.itch.io/]Ruben Tipparach[/url]. We're working towards hiring a new developer to help us scale the game. 


[u][b]Future Plans:[/b][/u]
We want to build [i]OMO: New Frontier[/i] so that it can easily accommodate new features and content over a long period of time. Give our Steam or [url=https://www.youtube.com/OnMyOwnGame]YouTube[/url] page a follow to stay up to date on our progress!


[u][b]Release Date:[/b][/u]
No release date yet, but our first target is getting an early access version of the game out on Steam [strike]later this year[/strike] ([b]Update:[/b] This was an internal goal, we'll keep you posted when we are getting closer to release).


What would you like to see in [i]OMO: New Frontier[/i]? Let us know in the comments below. Thanks for reading!


- Kyle

Lead Designer, Beach Interactive
